text:
maria: FYI planning a compact-rootfs cutover tomorrow 22:00 PT. scope: prune unused layers, rebuild minimal base, sign artifacts via KMS. Need RBAC + audit plan. anyone available to triage deps / keys?
jonah: I can pair on the rebuild. do we have a new KMS key or reuse images-signer-prod? :eyes:
alex: recommend new asymmetric KMS key for signing (RSA_PSS_3072) scoped to image-signing role. avoids sharing signer key with other teams.
tamika: Need to update IAM bindings: build-runner sa should get kms:Sign and kms:GetPublicKey for that key only. no kms:Decrypt on it. Also add condition for sourceIp of builder pool.
sec-bot: Reminder: key_rotation_policy must be set to 90d for prod signing keys. Existing key images-signer-prod expires 2026-01-15.
maria: +1 on new asymmetric key. alex, can you paste proposed policy snippet so infra can pre-flight?
alex: sure — minimal policy snippet:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/build-runner"},
      "Action": ["kms:Sign", "kms:GetPublicKey"],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {"IpAddress": {"aws:SourceIp": ["10.0.0.0/16"]}}
    }
  ]
}
```
jonah: For cosign+KMS flow we also need to ensure the CI has permission to call: iam:CreateServiceSpecificCredential? or just assume role into build-runner. we should avoid long-lived creds.
tamika: we'll use short-lived STS assume-role from the CI runner. add an audit log requirement: every sign event must be emitted to CloudTrail + pushed to centralized s3 bucket with prefix images/signs/<date>/ and forwarded to SIEM. retention 1y.
maria: ops: on failure fallback plan is to fail the cutover and keep current tags, and trigger incident runbook. Which runbook? oncall can you attach?
oncall: alpha-oncall will own the rollout window. Runbook link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ops/pages/IMG-CUTO-Runbook (copied). If sign step fails: revert to previous tag, block deploys, open incident channel #release-war-room.
jonah: small vuln triage: during builds we hit CVE-2025-0789 in libnss (low severity but present). plan: rebuild with updated distro package, re-run smoke and kernel-sandbox tests. anyone want to own vuln PR?
tamika: I can own the PR. will coordinate with release engineers. Also want to add an extra audit check in the image manifest to include cosign signature metadata and key id.
maria: good — tests we need: container runtime seccomp, non-root validation, image user mapping, and provenance fields present. Also add verification step in deploy pipeline: `cosign verify --key ksm://... image:sha256:...`
jonah: sample sign command I'll include in docs: 
```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key ksm://projects/PROJECT/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/ckey/cryptoKeyVersions/1 image:sha256:...
```
alex: note: KMS URI format varies per provider; include examples for AWS KMS and GCP KMS in runbook.
sec-bot: Policy check: RBAC change must be approved by sec-admins and recorded in audit ticket #SEC-8272.
maria: I'll open SEC-8272 now with summary and attach policy snippet + key ARN + rollout window.
maria: timeline: 22:00 PT build + sign stage, 22:30 PT canary deploy to staging replicas, 23:15 PT validate, 23:45 PT full cutover. if any step fails we abort and escalate.
tamika: temp checklist for infra before 22:00: create key, attach key policy, stash key ARN in vault, update CI assume-role trust policy, create CloudTrail trail to s3://redwood-audit/images/signs/, configure lifecycle (365 days), add SIEM forwarder.
jonah: I'll watch the build and cosign output. ping me with `@jonah` in the thread when you flip the window. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks all. I'll post SEC ticket and the final checklist here. after cutover we'll run a small audit assertion: query last 10 sign events and verify signer key id matches ARN.
alex: one more: add a permissive but monitored escape hatch: if KMS signing API is unavailable, allow a manual offline-signing process (approved by sec-admins) and require full forensics. document steps.
maria: agreed. postmortem expectations: if we use the escape hatch, 72h postmortem required.
tamika: pushing PR now for updated Dockerfile (minimal layers + remove curl-libs vulnerability). will tag `base-minimal:2026-03-24` when ready.
sec-bot: Automated vulnerability scan queued: scanning base-minimal:2026-03-24. status: queued.
maria: perfect. will check back at 21:30 PT for a final preflight. :shipit:
